request.text:
labels: Each pointed shirt-collar tip is attached to its own small button on the shirt body, separate from the central front buttons.; 셔츠의 뾰족한 깃끝 각각이 셔츠 몸판의 작은 단추에 고정되고 그 단추들은 중앙 앞단 단추와 별개다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: Each pointed shirt-collar tip is attached to its own small button on the shirt body, separate from the central front buttons.
aliases: 버튼다운 깃끝의 고정
